For some of us, identity cannot be implicit; it must be clear, defined and concrete (yet open to positive change)

If Identity and Charactersitcs are not defined, old ways will surely naturally default; paths of least resistance.

Our identity is only as defineable as our relationships and effects; our influence. This is precisely where idneityt emerges from;

> When I am miserable, and I focus on myself, I am miserable. When I am miserable, and I focus on who I influence, I am alive.
